title: Fundly

description.en: China mutual-fund browser and ranking tool with local SQLite and Railway
description.zh: 中国公募基金浏览与排名工具，采用本地 SQLite 存储并部署于 Railway。

subject: Charcoal emperor penguin head holding one small coral fish

source.description: China mutual-fund browser and ranking tool with local SQLite and Railway

subject.en: Charcoal emperor penguin head holding one small coral fish
subject.zh: 叼着一条小珊瑚色鱼的深炭色帝企鹅头部

previous.note: Previous penguin with binoculars. The still older flame SVG is archived but no longer shown in the before/after comparison.

description.en: A large head enters from the left edge, its beak holding one very small deep-sea fish. The right side stays open so the face carries the weight and the fish sits as a single punctuation.
description.zh: 大头从左边缘入框，喙尖叼着一条极小的深海鱼。右侧保留大片空白，重量集中在脸，鱼只是一处标点。

description.en: Connected flat facets step from deep charcoal through slate to warm ivory, with a muted amber ear patch echoing the product accent. The fish is the only saturated area, moving through coral, teal, amber and rose.
description.zh: 连贯碎面从深炭经岩灰过渡到暖象牙，低饱和琥珀耳斑呼应产品主色。全图只有鱼是饱和彩色，由珊瑚、青、琥珀与玫瑰色碎面组成。

description.en: Horizon lines sink and compress toward the lower right with short depth ticks in the open field. The field reads as a descent through water instead of a sightline across it, and it stays clear of the face.
description.zh: 水平线向右下缓慢下沉并收紧，空白处只留简短深度刻度。整片底图读作一次下潜，而不是一次远望，且始终避让面部。

sizeNote.en: The charcoal-to-ivory face and the small fish stay the main small-size cues. At 16 px the fish resolves to one warm spark. The 24 px sidebar and 16 px browser marks use the transparent penguin without its field.
sizeNote.zh: 深炭到象牙的面部对比与那条小鱼是小尺寸下的主要识别点；16 px 时鱼收拢成一点暖色。24 px 侧栏与 16 px 浏览器标记使用不带底图的透明企鹅。

goal.en: Collect fund and market data for private research into Chinese funds, ETFs, stocks, and macro conditions.
goal.zh: 采集基金与市场数据，用于研究中国公募基金、ETF、股票与宏观环境。

role.en: Collection scripts, HTTP server, and tests
role.zh: 采集脚本、HTTP 服务与测试

role.en: Local market data and computed metrics
role.zh: 本地市场数据与计算指标

role.en: Bun hosting with a persistent data volume
role.zh: Bun 服务与持久数据卷

description.en: A plausible vegetated subantarctic penguin coast, without asserting a penguin species: broad leathery coastal megaherb leaves with shallow scalloped margins and a few substantial folded tussock blades.
description.zh: 海岸叶荫：宽阔叶面与清晰叶脉形成浅浮雕，右侧疏密错落，左侧保留安静纸面。

description.en: Horizon lines sink and compress toward the lower right with short depth ticks in the open field.
description.zh: 水平线向右下缓慢下沉并收紧，空白处只留简短深度刻度。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥67px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine material detail softens at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 67px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小材质细节会柔化。
